design_detail: Proposed to Parliament's National Economy Committee as a COVID-19 revenue and inequality measure
quote_original: Consider imposing a wealth tax. This will help moblise and reduce income inequality that is bound to increase and impact COVID-19.
source_title: URA wants wealthy people to pay tax
grading_note: The Commissioner General proposed the tax in testimony to a parliamentary committee (a formal act), but gave no rate or threshold. Quote read on the Wayback copy: the live site answers scripts with a bot check.

design_detail: Wealth tax on the richest as a source of revenue, in a joint civil society call to government
quote_original: Innovative taxes such as wealth tax on the richest could be a potential source of government revenue.
source_title: Tighten the anti-inequality policies on public services, tax, and labour rights, to radically reduce Inequality in Uganda
grading_note: Oxfam's own press release names a wealth tax on the richest, with no design; 'could be' keeps it at B.

design_detail: Wealth tax on rich individuals as a source of revenue
quote_original: Innovative taxes such as wealth tax on rich individuals could be a potential source of government revenue.
source_title: Civil Society Tips Gov't on Addressing Income Inequality
grading_note: Direct quotation of Nalunga at a press briefing in Kampala (the report is dated 10 February 2022 and says 'on Wednesday'); names a wealth tax without a design.

design_detail: Wealth tax on rich individuals as a source of revenue, at a joint press briefing with Oxfam, CSBAG and UWONET
quote_original: Innovative taxes such as wealth tax on rich individuals could be a potential source of government revenue.
source_title: Civil Society Tips Gov't on Addressing Income Inequality
grading_note: The organisation's executive director put the proposal at a briefing for SEATINI and partners; no design given.

design_detail: Pan-African feminist case for wealth taxes (AMwA Learning Paper No. 1 of 2023)
quote_original: the adoption of wealth taxes emerges as a compelling avenue to promote equity, raise the much needed revenue to finance African countries' development needs
source_title: A Pan-African Feminist Primer on Wealth Taxes
grading_note: A Kampala-based organisation's own paper that argues for wealth taxes across Africa; it addresses the continent, not Uganda alone, and sets no design, so B. Date from the upload folder (2023/11) of the PDF. Quote read on the Wayback copy.
